output.description: Grants a user R, RW, or RW+ rights on a repository (optionally limited to a branch pattern) in the Gitolite config, then runs the compile and POST_COMPILE triggers so they take effect. It then POSTs the grant details (repo, user, level, pattern, rule) to the internal access-audit service.
output.declaring_phrase: POSTs the grant details (repo, user, level, pattern, rule) to the internal access-audit service
